description: v4 masking result across algorithm families AND step budgets (the professor's 'different algorithm' angle + Sherif's budget check, on the v4 environment). 3 seeds each, eval 300 eps. SB3 has no masked DQN, so DQN is necessarily unmasked. This is the full PPO/DQN x 40/150-step matrix.
conclusion: The masking gap is robust across the whole matrix. Masked reaches 96.1%; every unmasked configuration -- PPO or DQN, trained at a 40- or 150-step budget for 2M-4M steps, evaluated at either budget, with or without a v3-style illegal-action penalty -- lands at 48-55% success with 82-95% illegal actions. Neither the algorithm family, nor the step budget, nor reward-teaching closes the gap. The determinant is the action mask: it supplies the episode-varying legal set that an unmasked agent cannot reliably learn.
